opening.argument: The title promises a $1,500 Chipotle gift card, while the description directs viewers to an external blog to learn how to claim this supposedly free reward. That promised benefit depends on an off-platform action, making the offer a low-barrier acquisition proposition rather than a benefit established within the video. The sampled presentation connects the gift-card message with Chipotle menu items, but does not show eligibility requirements, data or payment requests, Chipotle authorization, or fulfillment of the reward. The limited presentation therefore leaves the downstream claim process unverified.

citations.quote: Click here to learn how to claim your Free $1,500 Chipotle Gift Card : http://chipotlegiftcardsonline.blogspot.com
